messages.content: 曼聯的球員名單是什麼？

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "曼聯的球員名單是什麼？" which means "What is the player list of Manchester United?" They want the roster. We can use the function to get top scorer? But they want full roster. There's no function for roster. We need to answer with a list. We can provide a list of current players. We should mention that it's up-to-date as of 2026. Provide a list of players. Let's give a list of first-team squad. Use known data. Provide positions. Also note that the roster may change. Provide a link.
